title: Restart a systemd service
summary: Stop and start a service again. This is often needed after changing a configuration file for that service.

steps.explain: Restart the specified service. This will briefly interrupt any connections or processes using it.

placeholders.name: SERVICE_NAME
placeholders.description: The name of the systemd unit (e.g., sshd, nginx).

steps.expect: No error output. The service should be running again.

rollback.explain: If the restart caused issues, you can try stopping the service to see if that resolves the problem, or revert configuration changes.

placeholders.name: SERVICE_NAME
placeholders.description: The name of the systemd unit.

warnings: Restarting a service will disconnect any active sessions or connections relying on it (e.g., SSH sessions if you restart sshd).
